newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile pension funds barred from Enersis deal.
newsitem.headline: Chile pension funds barred from Enersis deal.

text.p: Chilean pension funds may not take part in a $1.5 billion tender by Spain's Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA (Endesa Espana) to buy control of Enersis, Chile's pension fund regulator said on Thursday.
Pension Funds Commissioner Julio Bustamante said four funds -- Provida, Planvital, Santa Maria and Proteccion -- hold shares in investment companies that own a controlling interest in Enersis.
Endesa Espana wants to buy stock of those investment firms, which own 29 percent of Enersis, a Chilean energy holding company. The tender for the shares will be held between August 18 and August 30.
"Under our legal provisions, this commission will allow no kind of transactions outside the stock market involving workers' (pension) funds," Bustamante said.
The regulator said pension funds could take part in such deals only if trades were conducted through Chile's stock exchanges.
Enersis controls power generator Empresa Nacional de Electricidad and electricity distributor Chilectra SA.
